title: Synthesis and properties of L-lyxo-thioBsNA-pyrimidine nucleoside: a sulfur-containing analogue of boat-shaped pyranosyl nucleic acid
content:
RSC Chem. Biol., 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D6CB00034G, Paper
Open Access

Miyu Ito, Suguru Matsumoto, Natsuki Yokota, Hidekazu Hiroaki, Tetsuya Kodama
L-lyxo-thioBsNA, a boat-shaped nucleic acid (BsNA) analogue designed to enhance hydrophobicity – a property strongly influencing its physical characteristics – was synthesized.
